email.body1:
Dante, saw Prove launched its Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world and just raised $40M.

A launch and raise like that usually open more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps chase them all, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to move ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dante, quick follow-up for Prove.

After a platform launch, accounts in play jump faster than any team can staff for, and most leaders cannot say how many meetings it takes to cover them. The gap shows up late, then the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to cover that demand this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dante, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other funded startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dante, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right after the raise, no problem. Timing matters, and the launch-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
